Duties included but are not limited to the following: Assisting Business Manager and Medicine Admin Team to develop and maintain standards of work and policies related to duties and procedures.

Assists in developing new or modified administrative program policies, regulations, goals or objectives; identifies data required for use in the management direction of programs; develops management and/or program evaluation plans, procedures and methodology. Monitors status of service projects and recommends reallocation of resources as needed.

Conducts studies of employee/organizational efficiency and productivity and recommending changes or improvements in organization, staffing, work methods, and procedures. Troubleshoots pay issues with staff and works with Fiscal and HR to resolve these issues.

Utilize a variety of data sources and pull various reports to monitor and track key performance indicators and quality metrics for the department, i.e.

HR onboarding turnaround time, equipment procurement turnaround time, develop system for monitoring timeline, contract requirements being met and renewal/option year utilization, creates and/or maintains a visual management system (i.e. charts, graphs etc.) related to metrics and tracking systems.

Ensures the accuracy of the data being processed by performing routine and non-routine audits. The audits may be performed on source data from financial reports, VISTA or VHA financial systems. Independently collects, reviews and analyzes statistical data from various automated data systems used by VA.

Develops analytical tools to identify, format and reduce data for analysis, to provide information to management in an easily recognized format, or to assist other analysts and staff.

Acts as a liaison between Inpatient Medicine team and support services within the medical center which play a major role in management and program functioning (Environmental and Management Services, Logistics, BioMed, IT). Meets the needs of customers while supporting VA missions.

Consistently communicates and treats customers (Veterans, their representatives, visitors, and all VA staff) in a courteous, tactful and respectful manner. Provides the customer with consistent information according to established policies and procedures. Handles conflict and problems in dealing with the customer constructively and appropriately.

May be responsible for representing Inpatient Medicine at service staff meetings, facility-based meetings or committees, providing training and education, completion of special projects and/or reporting such as Performance Improvement Rapid Improvement Events (RIE) and Value Stream Analysis.

Promotion Potential: The selectee may be promoted to the full performance level without further competition when all regulatory, qualification, and performance requirements are met. Selection at a lower grade level does not guarantee promotion to the full performance level. Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement, 08/03/2026. Time-In-Grade Requirement: Applicants who are current Federal employees and have held a GS grade any time in the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

For a GS-06 position you must have served 52 weeks at the GS-05. The grade may have been in any occupation, but must have been held in the Federal service. An SF-50 that shows your time-in-grade eligibility must be submitted with your application materials.

If the most recent SF-50 has an effective date within the past year, it may not clearly demonstrate you possess one-year time-in-grade, as required by the announcement. In this instance, you must provide an additional SF-50 that clearly demonstrates one-year time-in-grade.

Note: Time-In-Grade requirements also apply to former Federal employees applying for reinstatement as well as current employees applying for Veterans Employment Opportunities Act of 1998 (VEOA) appointment.

You may qualify based on your experience as described below: Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Examples of specialized experience would typically include, but are not limited to: Experience in using data analysis to improve outpatient healthcare clinic operations, access, and productivity. Experience in streamlining healthcare administrative procedures, clinic workflows, and reports to meet program and regulatory needs.

Experience in independently completing healthcare administration projects and presenting results to clinical and administrative leaders. Experience in supporting provider credentialing and privileging, including OPPE/FPPE monitoring and documentation.

For more information on these qualification standards, please visit the United States Office of Personnel Management's website at https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/.

Our client is a leading Arizona litigation firm headquartered in Phoenix, focused on finding solutions to complex legal problems. The firm offers the expertise and results clients expect from large national firms — with a smaller footprint and a deeply personal approach.

The firm represents large and small businesses, entrepreneurs, individuals, and families, with a practice spanning commercial disputes, business litigation, civil rights, employment law, and other litigation matters.

The firm is hiring a Legal Admin Assistant to support its onshore attorneys and staff by keeping the operating rhythm of a busy litigation practice running cleanly.

This role owns the calendar, the docket, the document queue, and the administrative workflows that determine whether attorneys can focus on their cases or get pulled into the operational background.

You will manage multiple attorney calendars, track court dates and deadlines across the firm's practice areas, prepare and proofread legal documents to filing-ready quality, e-file with courts and agencies, process billing and expense reports, and maintain organized client files.

This is not a substantive drafting role — attorneys and onshore paralegals draft the legal arguments. Your work is the operational discipline that makes their drafting possible: nothing late, nothing lost, nothing un-filed, nothing un-billed.

Success at 90 days means a calendar attorneys trust, a docket that does not drift, billing that closes on schedule, and a document queue that is consistently filing-ready. Responsibilities Calendar & Docket Management
Docket court hearings across the firm's practice areas and maintain accurate deadline tracking for all assigned matters.
Manage attorney calendars, appointments, court dates, depositions, and case deadlines.
Set structured reminder cascades for all deadlines (e.g., 30-day, 14-day, 7-day, 2-day, day-of).
Flag scheduling conflicts and competing priorities to attorneys and onshore staff with sufficient lead time.
Meeting, Deposition & Travel Coordination
Coordinate internal meetings, client meetings, and depositions across multiple calendars and time zones.
Arrange travel logistics for attorneys (flights, accommodations, ground transport) and prepare itineraries.
Confirm logistics with court reporters, opposing counsel, and venue contacts as needed.
Billing, Invoicing & Expense Tracking
Track billable time entries, invoices, and expense reports across attorneys.
Flag missing time entries or expense documentation before billing close.
Process expense reimbursements and reconcile against firm records.
Document Preparation & Filing
Prepare, edit, proofread, and format legal documents and correspondence to filing-ready quality.
E-file legal documents with US courts and agencies through the firm's e-filing systems.
Prepare physical filing packages for the onshore team where physical filing is required.
Maintain version control and audit trails on documents under revision.
Case & Document Management
Assist with case management and document management systems to keep matter files complete and retrievable.
Maintain and organize client files and confidential records in line with the firm's data and privacy protocols.
Support intake of new matters including opening files, conflict checks, and initial documentation.
General Administrative Support
Perform general administrative duties including copying, scanning, mailing preparation, and data entry.
Ensure compliance with legal procedures, court rules, and firm protocols.
Perform other legal administrative tasks as assigned by the onshore team.

2 or more years of experience as a legal admin, legal assistant, or legal secretary supporting a US litigation practice (or strongly comparable international firm).
Direct experience managing multiple attorneys' calendars and court deadlines simultaneously.
Hands-on experience with at least one US court e-filing system (CM-ECF/PACER, AZTurboCourt, or similar).
Experience with a legal document management system (NetDocuments, iManage, Worldox, SharePoint, or similar).
Excellent written English — your proofreading catches errors before attorneys do; documents you prepare require minimal revision.
High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage deadline-driven work across multiple matters without error.
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while maintaining close coordination with an onshore team.
Reliable home office setup: high-speed internet, backup power or backup internet, quiet workspace, modern computer with webcam.

12+ months of direct remote experience supporting a US law firm.
Experience with legal billing software (Clio, TimeSolv, Bill4Time, or similar) and LEDES invoicing.
Familiarity with Arizona state court or US federal court docketing conventions.
Background supporting a commercial litigation, business litigation, or civil rights practice.
Full-time, 100% remote engagement.

Long-term, stable engagement with a respected US law firm.
Direct collaboration with an experienced onshore team and supervising attorneys.
A clearly scoped operational role — what success looks like is visible and measurable. Application Notes By applying, you consent to being contacted via the contact information provided in your application for recruitment purposes only.

Scheduling note: initial calls run in US Mountain Standard Time, within a 3:00 AM – 1:00 PM MST window — which translates locally to 6:00 PM – 4:00 AM in the Philippines, 1:00 PM – 11:00 PM in Kenya, 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM in South Africa, and 4:00 AM – 2:00 PM in Guatemala. We genuinely appreciate your flexibility around the time difference.

Tu aimes quand l-administration, la finance, les ventes et la technologie se rencontrent dans un même poste? Tu es à l-aise avec les chiffres, les processus, les outils digitaux et tu as envie d-évoluer dans un environnement IT stimulant?
Chez Swiss Post Digital Government SA, nous recherchons une personne confirmée, curieuse et structurée pour rejoindre notre équipe. Ce rôle va bien au-delà d-un poste administratif classique. Tu seras au cœur de nos activités opérationnelles, financières et commerciales, avec une forte exposition aux sujets IT tels que les licences logicielles, le matériel informatique et les commandes.
**Ton quotidien chez nous**
Dans ce rôle, tu joueras un rôle central dans le bon fonctionnement administratif, financier et opérationnel de nos activités de vente. Concrètement, tu seras amené à :
* Gestion des achats de matériel et licences
* Analyse et négociation des offres fournisseurs
* Suivi des commandes et livraisons
* Réception et contrôle du matériel
* Validation des factures fournisseurs
* Élaboration et suivi des offres commerciales
* Gestion des renouvellements clients et internes
* Facturation et suivi administratif des ventes
* Support aux équipes commerciales et financières
* Gestion des données dans l'ERP et les plateformes fournisseurs
* Suivi des licences et contrats
* Relations avec les clients et fournisseurs
Tu travailleras dans un environnement où les sujets peuvent être techniques, les processus exigeants et les interlocuteurs variés. Pour réussir, il te faudra aimer comprendre, creuser, apprendre et faire le lien entre plusieurs domaines.
**Ce que nous recherchons**
Nous cherchons une personne fiable, organisée et à l-aise dans un environnement professionnel exigeant, mais aussi quelqu-un qui a envie de comprendre ce qui se cache derrière les outils, les commandes, les licences et les services technologiques. Tu te reconnais dans le profil suivant :
* tu as une formation commerciale, par exemple un CFC d-employé de commerce ou une école de commerce, ou une formation technique avec une forte orientation administrative ;
* tu maîtrises très bien les outils bureautiques ;
* tu apprends rapidement de nouveaux outils et systèmes et tu es proactif dans l-implémentation de nouveaux outils;
* tu as un intérêt marqué pour les environnements IT et technologiques et tu es à l-aise avec des produits ou services techniques parfois complexes ;
* tu maîtrises très bien le français et l-anglais. L-allemand serait un atout apprécié.
Au-delà de ton parcours, nous recherchons surtout une personne capable de comprendre des environnements complexes, de poser les bonnes questions et de faire avancer les dossiers avec précision.
**Ce qui fera la différence**
Ce poste est à l-intersection de plusieurs mondes : administration, finance, ventes et IT. C-est précisément ce qui le rend riche et stimulant. Tu feras la différence par ta curiosité pour les outils digitaux, ta capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers en parallèle et ton aisance à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés.

Autonome, rigoureux et organisé, tu sais rester calme lorsque les priorités évoluent. Ton sens du service, ton orientation client et ton envie d-apprendre en continu seront de vrais atouts.
Une expérience avec **Dynamics 365** représente un avantage important. Si ce n-est pas le cas, une forte appétence pour les outils digitaux et l-envie d-apprendre seront indispensables.
**Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**
A Swiss Post Digital Government SA, nous recherchons bien plus que des compétences techniques. Nous aimons intégrer des personnalités **engagées**, **curieuses**et **force de proposition**, qui ont envie de contribuer à une aventure collective et à une dynamique positive.
Tu rejoindras des équipes **passionnées**, **collaboratives** et tournées vers l-**innovation**, dans une entreprise en pleine évolution où les idées, l-autonomie et l-initiative ont réellement leur place.
Et parce que l-équilibre compte aussi, nous proposons un environnement de travail flexible avec la possibilité de télétravailler 1 à 2 jours par semaine.
